title: Prove doubled centre Gram stabilization by width ten (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration for the pinned historical eight-by-112 doubled centre Gram.

```diff
- #6302: uniform degree bound 2^93; eventual stabilization without a width
+ actual generated Bell group has order 2^44
+ uniform rational annihilator has degree at most 2^47
+ the minimal polynomial is constant at every tensor width at least 10
```

The root coefficient occurs once, outside the tensor power. The stable polynomial is the minimal polynomial of the eight-row regular-action operator. The exact stable degree and width-two polynomial remain unknown. This is an algebraic side result, with no new kappa, supplier admission, physical decoder or selected-frontier change.

The original [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19530039) included uniform existence. The [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19537513) acknowledges merged #6302 and narrows novelty to the quantitative results above. Scientific base and refreshed canonical main are `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Krzysztof Wojt #5168 for the operator, one-slot degree 881 and original question; Ali Romman #4958/#4720/#5382 for the query, Bell identity and two-slot lower bound 1093; Nick Petalas #6302/#5120 for the earlier uniform and lower bounds; #1719 for the doubled representation; and Ali Romman's Clifford tensor Gram work for the finite-group and Burnside-Brauer viewpoint. The representation-theory ingredients are classical and cited in the proof. Predecessor spectral certificates are cited premises, not replayed as this deliverable.

## Evidence

- Before: the enclosing group in #6302 has order 2^90 and supplies no stabilization width. After: the actual group's label image has binary dimension 36 and its sign kernel has dimension 8. A faithful regular action bounds the degree by 8 times 2^44. At most eleven character values, the cited Burnside-Brauer theorem and the fixed Bell vector give stabilization by width ten.
- The finite verifier authenticates the query and computes both dimensions. Literal integer 512-by-512 Bell actions agree on 1,792 sampled label pairs over all 112 generators, covering both sign cases. The written identity handles all label pairs.
- Full enumeration of the two toy groups gives orders 64 and 16. Their kernels agree with the normal-closure algorithm, and every element satisfies the trace lemma. Four rejection controls pass. This does not enumerate the actual 2^44-element group or construct its huge regular matrix.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct runs pass with identical output. Each registered check runs well below its 120-second limit. Metadata/pins and the selected source-binding orientation pass. Functions are at most 42 lines, and in-memory compilation and diff whitespace checks pass.
- Committed-byte and declared source-history checks pass for all eleven package/input files at head `362a05a889ffc1ae923812f298a4186972be731e`. The official export passes integrity checking. Both verifier modes also pass in a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`, with all twelve exported file hashes unchanged. The verifier uses only the standard library and writes nothing. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Local environment: 3.12.15 (main, Oct 14 2026, 00:55:37) [Clang 23.1.3 ], macOS-27.0.1-arm64-arm-64bit, standard library only.

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Direct marker: `PASS_CENTRE_GRAM_WIDTH_STABILIZATION`. Registered marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations

The bound ten is sufficient, not claimed minimal. The stable polynomial and its degree are not computed; the universal quantifiers rest on the written proof and the cited classical theorem. The lower bounds 881 and 1093 are inherited, not new counts.

## Open next questions

- Determine which irreducibles occur at widths two through nine and compute the corresponding minimal polynomials. Start with the sign kernel and label-image extension; projective representation blocks and their exact spectra remain unresolved.
- Lower the stabilization-width bound by determining which trace values actually occur. The 36-dimensional binary matrix span makes direct enumeration too large.
- Bound the stable degree more sharply, or exhibit eigenvalues beyond the inherited lower bound. One small representation block could provide a bounded first step.

No predecessor scientific replay, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Physical access, coefficient preparation, dirty restoration, storage, routing, precision, compiler closure, complete supplier cost and outer multiplication remain outside this result.

- #7173 proves a total-rank floor for five commuting stages in a shortest query root.

The earlier #7132, #7133, #7134 and #7135 also study different objects or quantities. The overlap helper covered 466 open PR records and 7,089 Discussion records with complete remote pagination. Sparse local coverage was incomplete; separate Git-tree searches of main found #6302 and checked the sharper bound, group order and stabilization terms. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside this coverage.

## CI notes

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
```

At `tests/test_research_current_status.py:58`, the assertion expects `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` from the selected record in the current CI documentation section.
